name: Seng Fong Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过全资子公司Syarikat Tenaga (Gemas) Sdn. Bhd.收购了加纳公司Rainbow Rubber Buying Center Ltd 51%的股权，将业务扩展至加纳的橡胶加工领域。除此之外，公告中未见其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: During the year, the company, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Syarikat Tenaga (Gemas) Sdn. Bhd., acquired a 51% equity interest in Ghana-based Rainbow Rubber Buying Center Ltd, expanding its operations into rubber processing in Ghana. Apart from this, no other expansion, reduction, or contract developments were announced for the business segments.

segments.name: 杯胶加工
segments.note: 今年通过收购加纳公司RRBC 51%股权，将杯胶加工业务扩展至加纳。
segments.note_en: This year, through the acquisition of a 51% stake in Ghana-based RRBC, the cup lump processing business was expanded into Ghana.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购RRBC 51%股权已完成，加纳公司注册处确认相关登记。
actions.text_en: The acquisition of a 51% equity interest in RRBC was completed, with confirmation from the Office of the Registrar of Companies, Republic of Ghana.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以GHS280,500（约RM100,500）收购Rainbow Rubber Buying Center Ltd 51%股权，该公司在加纳从事橡胶加工业务。
actions.text_en: Acquired a 51% equity interest in Rainbow Rubber Buying Center Ltd for GHS280,500 (approximately RM100,500); the company is engaged in rubber processing in Ghana.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购加纳RRBC 51%股权，将业务版图扩展至加纳的橡胶加工领域。
model_changes.text_en: Expanded its business footprint into rubber processing in Ghana through the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in Ghana-based RRBC.
